messages:
deploy-bot: [ALERT] edge-proxy: traffic spike from 203.0.113.0/24 ASN 64500 — 12k RPS to /v1/stream, 45% 503s. alert_id=edge-traffic-1761234567
alyssa: I'm seeing huge fanout on the streaming endpoint, lots of short-lived connections, identical query params. looks botty not legit users.
mike: creating incident page (INC-2026-176123). initial severity P1 for availability, paging oncall. can we apply emergency rate limits?
sofia: recommend temporary WAF rule + per-ip rate limit on /v1/stream and challenge (aio) for requests matching UA regex. block ASN 64500 for now. keep changes minimal and reversible.
ranjit: I'll push a scoped WAF change via deploy-bot, will annotate change and link to incident. ensure change is logged to audit logs.
deploy-bot: applying playbook: waf-rule create -> block ASN 64500 (rule_id=wr-7621), rate-limit /v1/stream 10r/s per-ip (policy rl-331). change via infra-runbook 4.2.
alyssa: traffic dropped ~82% in 90s after rule applied. 503s dropped back to baseline. monitoring in progress. :white_check_mark:
sofia: good. ticketed follow-ups: 1) review RBAC for WAF changes (limit to secops/sre), 2) ensure all deploy-bot keys are KMS-backed and audit-logged, 3) add canary and test harness for WAF rules.
mike: customer comms draft: "We observed elevated transient errors on streaming endpoints due to abusive traffic; mitigations applied and service returned to normal. No customer data impacted." post to status page in 30m unless objection.
ranjit: created INFRA-5123 (waf/rate-limit runbook improvements) and SEC-223 (rbac & audit log policy). linking to incident.
alyssa: note — our current runbook updates are too manual. we need a dry-run mode for WAF rules and synthetic tests. add to INFRA-5123.
sofia: also: add signal to early-detect ASN churn and high-similarity UA patterns. create heartbeat for streaming SLO alert.
mike: action items assigned: ranjit -> implement dry-run + playbook improvements; alyssa -> synthetic test harness; sofia -> RBAC audit + KMS key review; ops -> rotate deploy-bot API key and ensure KMS audit trail. target completions: 2 weeks.
alyssa: after-action note: ensure all infra changes get a CC to secops channel and are captured in the change audit table (retention 90d).
ranjit: rolled back block for one false-positive ASN shortly after — rollback annotated in audit log. all changes now in one PR for approval.
sofia: postmortem scheduled tomorrow. include runbook gaps, RBAC, KMS logging, and automation to push WAF rules with canary.
mike: incident downgraded to resolved after 6h of monitoring. will publish a short postmortem and assign follow-ups. :memo:
alyssa: closing notes: no data compromise, mitigations effective, follow-ups created. thanks team. :tada:
